title: Review Checkpoint: Evidence-Graph Foundation On Target
goal: Step back after #321-#323 and verify the evidence-graph adoption work is on track. Confirm graph entities flow end-to-end from runners through ingestion helpers into the picker context. Catch architectural drift before committing to Phase 2.
scope: Operator + agent review of work merged from backlog-371, -372, -373. Live test on at least 2 contrasting targets (Gruyere + one non-Gruyere) showing graph-aware picker decisions. Written checkpoint report with go/no-go on Phase 2.
generation_reason: Per operator request 2026-05-15: 'Zet in die taken na x aantal taken een taak om het allemaal weer netjes te controleren en te zorgen dat we on target blijven.' This is the first such checkpoint, gating Phase 2 (universal auth + pattern cache).

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Review only. No production code changes. Output is a checkpoint report and a yes/no decision on Phase 2 promotion.
constraints.decision_gate: If review surfaces architectural drift or scope creep, the report must identify the corrective task before #325 is promoted.

success_criteria: docs/checkpoints/2026-mythos-phase1-review.md exists with: (a) what was built, (b) what works, (c) what is broken, (d) any deviation from #371 audit plan, (e) explicit go/no-go for Phase 2.
Live picker run on Gruyere shows graph entities consumed in decision context (logged or recorded in report).
Live picker run on one non-Gruyere target (e.g. juice-shop or demo.testfire.net) shows graph entities consumed.
AGENT_SYSTEM_MAP.md section 4 is updated to reflect post-Phase-1 reality.
If go: backlog-375 is promoted into NEXT_TASK.md. If no-go: corrective task is identified and queued.

acceptance_criteria: Checkpoint report names specific evidence-graph entities visible in picker context on at least 2 targets.
Phase 2 go/no-go decision is explicit and justified.
Any drift from #371 audit is named and either accepted or scheduled to be corrected.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
Tasks #321, #322, #323 must show as DONE in DONE_LOG.md.
after_completion: Promote backlog-375 (or corrective task) into NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Reopening Phase 1 scope unless drift is documented.
